items: Your AI judge now looks at the photos themselves, not just body landmarks: each posing photo gets a grade and a 0-10 score for muscularity, conditioning, symmetry, proportion, presentation and execution, plus the body parts that lag. Side poses get graded too. It leads in Pose Studio; the geometry measurement stays below it as a check.

New check-in review: the AI puts each check-in's photos beside your earlier ones of the same pose and tells you your visual body-fat range, whether conditioning is improving, what improved and what lags. The latest one leads the Dashboard.
The coach also sees your latest check-in photos. Photos go only into the cowork folder you pick, downsized and with location data removed, and you can switch that off on the Dashboard.

Choose a theme on the Dashboard, under the font picker: the house themes every app shares, plus this app's own Ink and Marble. Until you choose, the app follows your device: Ink when it is dark, Marble when it is light.
The app now speaks 16 more languages: pick yours under the font picker. They are machine translated from English, so some wording may be off. Pose names and posing cues stay in English for now.

New in your coach folder: an AI review of each graded posing photo, with a letter grade, strengths, fixes and one thing to drill next. You check it before it's added, it appears beside the app's own score in Pose Studio, and you can undo it.
While Google Drive sync is on, your Google picture now sits at the top of the app on every screen, so you can always see which account is syncing. Tap it to open the sync settings.
Photos taken late in the evening are now filed under the right day, wherever you live.
New on the Backup page: erase everything this app keeps on this device. Your Drive copy stays safe.
Before you pick an athlete, the app matches your device's light or dark setting.
New coaching advice from your coach folder now waits for you to review it before it replaces the old advice, and you can undo it.
Easier-to-read text by default, and you can choose a different font on the Dashboard.
